svg.title: Agents work with any tool
svg.desc: The agent reaches ElevenLabs voices through an API, image generation through MCP, and Blender and ffmpeg through their command lines. Each tool's result becomes a file in your project (voice.wav, cover.png, intro.blend, teaser.mp4), and Retake, watching the project folder, sees each change.
svg.text: MCP, a command line or an API. Retake only watches the files.
